specs.title: 3. Non-admin users calling /api/admin/* receive HTTP 403 Forbidden
4. Admin promotes customer to teacher and writes audit log
5. Admin provisions a new teacher account and verifies profile & audit log
6. Admin bank accounts CRUD and disabled account filtered out of checkout
7. Updating settings updates database, public footer, and audit log
1. Non-admin (customer) calling product mutations receives HTTP 403 Forbidden
2. Product images upload enforces admin authorization and file validation
3. Admin creates product with 3 images; dynamically visible on /products and landing page
4. Toggling product availability hides from public catalog and disables ordering
5. Public /products/[id] renders gallery, specs, price, and Add to Cart/Order controls
6. Public /products catalog filters by search, category pills, and pagination
7. Product deletion enforces soft-delete when referenced in orders
1. Customer orders, uploads proof, admin approves, customer sees approved with timeline
2. Admin rejects with a reason, customer sees the reason, re-uploads, status returns to pending_verification
3. Cross-customer isolation: Customer cannot open another customer's order API, detail, or signed proof URL
4. Privilege Escalation Block: Customer cannot approve their own payment or transition to approved
5. Server computes price strictly from DB; price tampering has no effect; unavailable products rejected
6. State Machine Validation: Invalid status jumps are rejected with HTTP 400
7. Storage Validation: Wrong file format (.exe) and oversized file (>5 MB) are rejected
8. Admin can create an order on behalf of a customer and it appears in customer portal
1. Last-seat race with two customers: exactly one succeeds, the other sees 'full'
2. Duplicate registration blocked for same customer
3. Past sessions are not registerable
4. Teacher A cannot see or fetch Teacher B's roster (API returns 403 / empty)
5. Customer cannot approve an enrollment, cannot see other students' rosters
6. Admin cancelling a class notifies enrolled students
7. Attendance saved and visible to admin
8. Customer Registration UI, cancellation before approval, and Join Button state
1. Unapproved student token request: returns 403
2. Approved student token decodes to canPublish: false and no roomAdmin
3. Teacher token decodes to roomAdmin: true and canPublish: true
4. Student calling start, end, mute, remove, permissions: all return 403
5. Teacher B starting Teacher A's session: returns 403
6. Student cannot get a token before the session is live / within the 10-minute window
7. Webhook endpoint verifies signature and keeps status in sync
8. Host studio page (/teacher/live/[id]): loads camera, mic, controls, and End Session dialog
9. Student live page (/dashboard/live/[id]): pre-join check, live viewer, and no-access screen
1. Cross-customer isolation: Customer cannot view another customer's design row or file
2. Privilege escalation block: Customer cannot set status to quoted or edit quoted price
3. Upload validation: Invalid file type and oversized files are rejected
4. Full Lifecycle Flow: Submit -> Admin Quotes -> Customer Accepts -> Order Created -> Payment Flow
5. UI Verification: Customer /dashboard/designs and Admin /admin/designs

suites.title: Phase 9: Realtime Notifications, Audit Log & Admin Dashboard

specs.title: 1. Cross-User Notification Isolation: User A cannot read or mark User B's notifications
2. Realtime Bell & Notifications Page: Admin action updates customer bell live
3. W8 Triggers: Order, enrollment, class cancellation, and live session create notifications
4. Admin Dashboard Metrics: Real DB numbers match direct SQL counts with zero fakes
5. Audit Log Explorer: Search, filter by action/entity/date, and inspect metadata
